immutable_artifact_principle: A preview and production promotion must use the same content-addressed Pages artifact. A post-preview rebuild is not certifiable.

critical_contracts.AUTH_ACCESS: same-origin Access projection only; private routes fail closed
critical_contracts.ROOT_ROUTING: root and legacy /kabuby routes resolve without loops
critical_contracts.HOME_TODAY_OPPORTUNITIES: consume the same authenticated Physical projection and never calculate commercial truth in the browser
critical_contracts.PRODUCT_DOSSIERS: display server-projected identity, decision and unknowns only
critical_contracts.SCOUT: SCOUT_CANONICAL_PRODUCTION_BASELINE_V1 and its scope exception gate
critical_contracts.SCOUT_CHROME_HANDOFF: owner capture target remains /#scout?view=pendientes with one owner session
critical_contracts.PRIVATE_EXECUTOR_CONTROL_PLANE: no public executor route or caller-selected provider input
critical_contracts.D1_SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY: EXPAND -> compatible code -> migrate/use -> verify -> contract later

rollback.reason: Cloudflare Pages Git integration has no safe repository-owned artifact-promotion rollback primitive. An immutable deployment pointer is required.
